# Fares Ashraf

> Fares Ashraf (فارس أشرف) is a digital marketer, designer and developer based in Cairo, Egypt. He has 6 years of experience in digital marketing and has worked with 15+ brands and agencies in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the UAE, Turkey and Germany. He serves businesses in Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and Europe, in Arabic and English.

Contact: farsashraf44@gmail.com · WhatsApp +20 106 279 2254 (https://wa.me/201062792254)

## Services

- Performance marketing and media buying on Meta (Facebook, Instagram), Google Search and Shopping, Snapchat and TikTok
- Lead generation: lead forms, messaging campaigns, retargeting, customer-data audiences
- Tracking, testing and reporting: Meta Pixel and Conversions API audits, conversion paths, A/B tests
- Content and creative direction, with copy in Egyptian, Saudi and Gulf Arabic and in English
- Graphic design: social posts, ad creatives, carousels, brand kits
- Motion graphics and video: Reels and TikToks, animated ads, explainers
- Lifestyle and product photography
- E-commerce stores: setup, payment gateways, product catalogue, tracking
- Systems and full-stack software: web apps, dashboards, CRMs, APIs
- AI systems: RAG chat assistants trained on a business's own content, workflow automation, LLM integrations

## Selected results (sourced on the site)

- Sereno Egypt (outdoor furniture, 2024–2026): +200% qualified leads and sales from EGP 12M to 50M (company reporting); 127,192 link clicks at EGP 2.35 each (Meta Ads Manager, Oct 2024 – Aug 2025)
- A Prolight Media client (Saudi Arabia): Instagram profile visits up 335.8% versus the previous 11 days (Meta Ads Manager, 28 Oct – 7 Nov 2024)
- Also: Aseer Time (Saudi Arabia, Qatar), Smart Solutions × UP VELA (UAE), Palmenburg (Germany, remote)
